name: Mezzio
description: The Mezzio is the middle tier of New Capenna, its largest and most densely populated borough and the city's cultural and commercial heart, between Park Heights and the Caldaia.

timeline.summary: Perrie enters a Mezzio lounge to find Krent and is confronted by two Cabaretti bouncers.
timeline.quote: "If you weren't hassling me, there'd be nothing to disturb your customers about,"

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: The bouncers taunt Perrie as a contract breaker, and he beats both of them.
timeline.quote: "Good kitty," he says softly to the bouncer on his right with a wink.

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Rigo finds Perrie in the alley and tells him to stand down and takes him to Nido Sanctuary by teleport.
timeline.quote: a flash of white light envelops them as Rigo teleports them off to their headquarters.

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth survives by taking odd jobs in New Capenna, still feeling the hollow left by Godsend.
timeline.quote: She kept her head down and took odd jobs throughout the city as she could find them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: A leonin bumps into Elspeth, triggering a memory of her reunion with Ajani on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: "You're alive!" Ajani raced to her.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth hears the shopkeeper being beaten over a debt and intervenes against four Maestro enforcers.
timeline.quote: "Anyone who finds sadistic pleasure in beating up an unarmed man makes themselves my business."

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth leads the Maestro enforcers on a chase through the Mezzio and ends up cornered at a half-built bridge.
timeline.quote: The road she'd been running down ended abruptly, a half-finished bridge extending out into empty air.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth grabs a steel rod and knocks out all four enforcers without killing them.
timeline.quote: rendered him unconscious with a thud

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo applauds, offers Elspeth work with the Maestros and mentions Halo.
timeline.quote: Why don't you start with the Maestros?

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Anhelo shows Elspeth a fountain statue of an angel fighting a spined creature, which Elspeth recognizes as a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: Anhelo might not know what it was, but she certainly did.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth reluctantly accepts the Maestros' offer to gain information on the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "All right," Elspeth reluctantly agreed.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 2: Dirty Laundry" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Echo Readers show a four-person spellcasting team, with Lacey bringing them Halo, before a spell devoured the warehouse.
timeline.quote: Something stuck, and it devoured the room.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth delivers a sealed package to an Obscura door in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: Elspeth placed the package in her palm and promptly left.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 3: Tests" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien meets her Obscura contact Navy in the Mezzio, trading information about the Font and the Adversary's lounge while hiding what she knows.
timeline.quote: "Not yet, but I'll find out," Vivien lied.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Navy gives Vivien a lead that a woman named Elspeth is taking odd jobs in the Mezzio.
timeline.quote: "Oh, I got a lead on your Elspeth character, however."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien sees a woman fight off Maestro enforcers in the street and then watches her give her name to the vampire Anhelo.
timeline.quote: The woman ignored the gesture, continuing to walk before she said, "Elspeth."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien goes to the Adversary's lounge hoping Elspeth will arrive as a Maestro, refuses to drink Halo, and sneaks some into a vial.
timeline.quote: Vivien could sneak some of the Halo out of the lounge and back to Urabrask without arousing suspicion.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien spots Navy slipping out the back and overhears her as a double agent arranging with a Maestro for the Crescendo.
timeline.quote: Navy was a double agent.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien hears a deep, vaguely familiar chuckle from a hidden room revealed in the lounge.
timeline.quote: She heard a deep chuckle echo from the back somewhere.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Navy ambushes Vivien outside the lounge with a dagger, saying the boss does not like people sniffing near his doorstep.
timeline.quote: "And the boss doesn't like people sniffing this close to his doorstep."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Vivien stabs Navy in the gut, tells her to seek the Obscura for help, and takes her notebook.
timeline.quote: with one hand she caught Navy by her forearm.

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, Vivien and Giada flee across the Mezzio; Elspeth decides to retrieve a better weapon from the Maestros' museum.
timeline.quote: "I need a better weapon than a knife.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt flees across the Mezzio rooftops pursued by Ognis and two male viashino.
timeline.quote: the roof shuddered under the shocking weight of the viashino

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Cornered, Kitt drops the gown bag over the edge to fool Ognis and leaps into the chasm singing.
timeline.quote: Opening her hand, she let go of the bag.

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Jinnie leads them to an Obscura hideout where Kamiz welcomes them, and a wounded Jetmir is being treated.
timeline.quote: "I see you were successful." Jetmir was settled in a lower bunk

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada makes Halo to heal Jetmir, but Riveteers and Maestro assassins burst in, and Elspeth and Vivien break free of their shackles.
timeline.quote: With a thought, her magic cracked open the locks

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is mortally wounded in the brawl, seeing Erebos's cold approach, until Giada feeds her Halo that heals her.
timeline.quote: It smashed into her ribs as Elspeth had been straining to hoist her sword

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada's Halo mends Elspeth's bones; Elspeth sees Giada's glow.
timeline.quote: Wounds mended.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 5: Hymn of the Angels" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Errant wakes in an abandoned station when a converter beast crashes through the wall, hunting her and Parnesse.
timeline.quote: The crash of a Phyrexian converter beast plunging through the wall had shattered their brief reprieve.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant and Parnesse flee over rails and ledges with stolen Riveteer explosives, using tagger's scrawl to find safe paths.
timeline.quote: The two heavy satchels that were laden with the explosives they had stolen from an old Riveteer's stash in the Mezzio clanked against her hips

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Cornered by two converter beasts, Errant and Parnesse choose to blow themselves up rather than be converted.
timeline.quote: "I love you until every canvas is filled."

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Errant reunites with Parnesse and her allies at the safe zone as the angels depart.
timeline.quote: "Parnesse!" Errant opened her arms just in time for Parnesse to throw herself into them.

citation.work: March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights
citation.text: "March of the Machine | New Capenna: The Fall of Park Heights" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The tower of New Capenna collapses on Atraxa and kills her.
timeline.quote: it is the city itself. The gleaming glass and steel tower of New Capenna collapses atop her

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rigo builds a network of newsies, pickpockets and errand runners and is accepted into the Brokers in Mezzio.
timeline.quote: he was soon formally accepted into the Brokers' fold within the Mezzio
